findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md:20-45 says storyFilesHash is recorded alongside materialHash and applies to review escalation host verdicts plus degraded fallback records, but the producer commands still do not record or accept storyFilesHash. review_escalation_fallback_set only imports/currentMaterialHash and writes materialHash in packages/main/src/handlers/review-escalation.ts:4,68-89,103-118; autopilot_review_submit has no storyFilesHash schema field in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:1983-1998 and appends host_verdict without storyFilesHash in packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:190-203. Command-produced escalation records therefore cannot satisfy the documented adopted binding; only manually/synthetically seeded events with storyFilesHash can get the downgrade.

doc-promise-undelivered: storyFilesHash is registered/promised for REVIEW/TEST/DONE freshness gates, but the DONE test-evidence path remains materialHash-only. process-fact-levels.ts:293 promises REVIEW/TEST/DONE freshness gates for verification evidence and story-files-hash-material-drift.md:40-60 defines storyFilesHash downgrade semantics. However phase-gates.ts:551-558 writes test-evidence.json with headHash/materialHash only, verifier.ts:544-555 does the same in persistStoryValidationEvidence, TestEvidenceData in types.ts:685-708 has no storyFilesHash field, and done-oracle.ts:181-188 calls checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit without evidence.storyFilesHash while DONE snapshot checking at done-oracle.ts:151-162 compares only materialHash. An unrelated main merge can therefore still fail the DONE evidence-freshness row despite unchanged story-owned files, so the documented/registered DONE adoption is not implemented.
